eligibility: Use one source record per 2023 nominal 600 s slot with the pilot one-second proximity criterion, preserving source timestamps. Refuse a colliding slot. Require all metric inputs finite, compute power positive, branch flows nonnegative and summed flow positive. Never impute or replace records; keep signed temperature and cached published heat.
quantile: Linear interpolation at zero-based sorted rank (n-1)*p.
day_median_rank: Percent of included annual observations less than or equal to the day median. Day observations are part of the annual sample.
